MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
UNWIND nodes(p) AS item
WITH DISTINCT item
WHERE item.tag IS NOT NULL
MATCH (item)-[:DESCRIBED_BY]->(dev:Resource)
CALL {
  WITH item, dev
  MATCH (d)
  WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(caseNode:plm__PCA_100029524)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(section:plm__PCA_100029513)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(footnote)
  WHERE toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(caseNode.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(section.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(section.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
  RETURN item.tag AS tag,
         d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
         d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS value,
         caseNode.rdfs__label AS case_label,
         footnote.plm__PCA_100029522 AS footnote,
         section.plm__PCA_100029521 AS source_title,
         section.dct__type AS source_type,
         section.dct__description AS source_description,
         d.schema__pageStart AS page
  UNION
  WITH item, dev
  MATCH (section:plm__PCA_100029513)
  WHERE section.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (toLower(coalesce(section.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(section.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure')
  RETURN item.tag AS tag,
         null AS label,
         null AS value,
         null AS case_label,
         null AS footnote,
         section.plm__PCA_100029521 AS source_title,
         section.dct__type AS source_type,
         section.dct__description AS source_description,
         section.schema__pageStart AS page
}
RETURN tag, label, value, case_label, footnote, source_title, source_type, source_description, page
ORDER BY tag, label, page
LIMIT 200
